summary: Terminal 2 does not use a strict permanent domestic-vs-international gate number split. Many gates are swing (MARS) stands and assignments change by schedule. All passengers use the same security checkpoints; after security, domestic passengers follow Domestic gate signage (no immigration), while international passengers proceed through Immigration then to international gates. Always confirm gate number and domestic/international on your boarding pass and on FIDS screens.
levels_hint: Level 3 is heavily used for domestic departures; Level 4 includes international departures and shared check-in. Walking distances in the X-shaped terminal can be 10–20+ minutes to distant gates.
